name: Cassia Phuket
short_description: A 218-unit serviced-apartment hotel in the Laguna Phuket complex in Bang Tao, with full kitchens in every unit and a free shuttle boat to the beach, 200m away.
ai_summary: Cassia Phuket is a serviced-apartment hotel within the Laguna Phuket complex in Bang Tao, opened by Banyan Tree in 2015 as a hybrid of hotel and long-stay apartment living. Its roughly 218 studios, one-bedroom lofts and two-bedroom suites all include full kitchens, and the property markets itself as Phuket's first fully pet-friendly hotel, with in-room pet amenities and a dedicated dog park. It sits about 200 meters from Bang Tao Beach rather than directly on the sand, reached by a free shuttle boat. Guests and independent reviewers consistently praise the friendly, vibrant atmosphere and the practicality of in-suite kitchens for families and pet owners, while recurring complaints cover loud restaurant background music audible in some rooms and mid-range rather than luxury finishes.

core_facts.address: 64 Moo 4, Srisoonthorn Road, Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket 83110, Thailand
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Full kitchen in every unit, from studios to two-bedroom suites, ideal for families and extended stays
Phuket's first fully pet-friendly hotel, with in-room pet amenities, a dog park and leash-free trails
Consistently friendly, vibrant staff and atmosphere praised across reviews
Two swimming pools, a kids' club and Cassia FIT gym on-site
Free shuttle boat to Bang Tao Beach, about 200m away
cons: Not directly beachfront -- about a 200m shuttle-boat ride to reach Bang Tao Beach
Some rooms above the on-site restaurant report loud background music affecting the stay
research_highlights: Marketed and reviewed consistently as Phuket's first genuinely pet-friendly hotel, a distinctive positioning versus other Laguna Phuket properties
In-suite kitchens across all categories are the most repeated practical praise from guests and reviewers
Opened by Banyan Tree in October 2015 as a new hybrid hotel/serviced-apartment concept
research_watchouts: Unit count varies across sources: 218 (Phuket101, most recent independent count), 221 (Sleeper Magazine at 2015 opening), and figures as high as 308-334 elsewhere that likely mix hotel-bookable units with total owned residences -- this entry uses the 218 figure
At least one guest review alleges inconsistent treatment of Asian guests around a booking dispute -- an isolated report, not corroborated elsewhere

faqs.question: Is Cassia Phuket pet-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes -- Cassia Phuket markets itself as Phuket's first fully pet-friendly hotel, offering in-room pet amenities such as memory-foam pet beds, air purifiers and biodegradable waste bags, plus a dedicated dog park and leash-free nature trails near the lotus lagoon, making it a genuine standout for travelers bringing large dogs.

faqs.question: Is Cassia Phuket on the beach?
faqs.answer: Not directly -- the hotel sits about 200 meters back from Bang Tao Beach within the Laguna Phuket complex, and guests reach the sand via a free shuttle boat rather than walking straight out. It's still considered a beach-adjacent stay given the short, included transfer.

reviews.title: Cassia Phuket
reviews.author: Willy Thuan
reviews.summary: Local Phuket guide calls the property young, vibrant and colourful with very friendly staff, praising in-suite kitchens for families but noting it sits 200m from the beach, reached by shuttle boat.

reviews.title: Banyan Tree to open Cassia Phuket
reviews.summary: Hospitality trade publication covers Banyan Tree's new Cassia concept ahead of its October 2015 opening, describing 221 apartment-style residences with kitchens and colourful street-art design.
